annotation.title_clean: Declaración de Santiago "Para promover una inteligencia artificial ética en América Latina y el Caribe"
annotation.title_en: Santiago Declaration "To Promote Ethical Artificial Intelligence in Latin America and the Caribbean"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerial and High Authorities Summit of Latin America and the Caribbean (Chile, UNESCO, CAF)
annotation.venue: Cumbre Ministerial y de Altas Autoridades de América Latina y el Caribe, Santiago de Chile
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ministerial declaration by Latin American and Caribbean states promoting ethical, human-rights-based AI governance anchored in the UNESCO Recommendation. It commits to analysing new legal frameworks and creates a Working Group, led by Chile, toward an intergovernmental AI Council for the region. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Countries to base AI policies on UNESCO Recommendation and its readiness and ethical impact assessment tools
Agree to begin analysis of new legal frameworks and regulatory agendas for AI
Establish Working Group led by Chile toward an intergovernmental AI Council for LAC
Prioritise monitoring AI's labour impact, capacity building, inclusion and gender equity
Promote data governance, shared compute infrastructure and regional innovation
